title: Populations and territories: the State reaches further
goal: Describe how people lived and travelled, with impersonal *se*.

items: I can say what people in general did, with *se* + a singular verb.
I can say how roads, railways and the telegraph changed life in isolated regions.
I can say how the State counted and registered its people.
I can use the words *el censo*, *la carretera*, *el servicio militar* and *aislado*.
